SUMMARYDec 2024 - PresentLead Data Scientist, Coromandel International Limited

Led the development of churn prediction models for a major retail business, enabling targetedmarketing campaigns that reduced churn by 20% and generated ₹40 Cr in incremental revenue.

Architected and implemented a phosphoric acid loss prediction system, integrating model outputsinto the Distributed Control System(DCS) and automating key process controls through reverseengineering. Achieved a 2% increase in throughput and 7% reduction in losses, contributing ₹150 Crin revenue impact.

Designed a RAG-based chatbot for manufacturing plants’ Document Management Systems, enablingnatural-language search, automated document clean-up, assisted maintenance activity in plants andused for onboarding support as plants had high-attrition.

Developed an agent-based HR operations chatbot with transactional capabilities (leave, attendance,travel) and policy query support, reducing HR workload and enabling expanded training initiativesthat improved policy understanding and overall employee experience.Lead Data Scientist with 9+ years of experience specializing in predictive modeling, GenAI, RAG systems,computer vision, NLP and risk analytics. Experienced in architecting and deploying production-grade AIsolutions that automate complex workflows, improve decision-making, and drive significant businessvalue. Designed GenAI-based test case generation models using BRDs and ERDs, achieving 80%automation of test cases with 95% accuracy, significantly reducing manual QA effort

Built ML models to classify bug reports by category, priority, and impact scope, enabling engineeringteams to better triage issues and improving overall bug resolution time by 10%.

Developed sentiment analysis models to assess merchant sentiment on Uber Eats across bugresolution, engagement, and onboarding workflows, providing actionable insights for product andsupport teams.

Created computer vision pipelines to automatically extract menu items and pricing information fromrestaurant uploaded images and PDFs during onboarding, converting them into structured formats fordownstream systems.
